svg.title: A LastValue conflict, the reads that fail after it, and the repair
svg.desc: A sequence on four lifelines: your code, the Pregel loop, the nodes a and b, and InMemorySaver. invoke starts the run. The loop runs a and b, and each finished node has its write to x saved as a pending write on checkpoint step 0: x=2 from b and x=1 from a. Then apply_writes calls LastValue.update with two values and raises InvalidUpdateError. A later get_state reads the same pending writes and raises again, through ['main.py:1496', 'main.py:1331', '_algo.py:319', 'last_value.py:64']. invoke(None) reapplies the writes, runs no node, and raises again. In the lower block, the same saver is opened by the graph recompiled with x: Annotated[int, operator.add]. get_state returns {'x': 3}, and invoke(None) finishes with the same state and runs no node.
